# Findings: Student Enrolment Analysis

*All figures come from synthetic data generated by `src/generate_data.py`.*

## Headline numbers

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Applications analyzed | 11,395 |
| Offer rate | 76.8% |
| Yield (offers that became enrolments) | 57.1% |
| Students enrolled | 4,999 |
| Retained into next term | 84.4% |

## 1. International applications fell sharply
Fall international applications dropped **50%** from 2023F to 2025F
(1,316 to 657), while domestic applications grew slightly.
First-term tuition from new Fall students moved from **$5,586,000** to **$3,693,950**.
This pattern is consistent with the study-permit caps introduced in 2024.

## 2. International offers convert far less often
Domestic yield is **68.7%**, international **38.0%**.
The biggest gap is after acceptance: only **66.7%** of international
students who accept actually enrol (domestic: 91.3%), which points to visa
and arrival problems rather than lack of interest. Among international channels, Referral converts at
**34.7%** of applications versus **29.0%** for Agent.

## 3. Practical Nursing is capacity-limited
Nursing offers a seat to only **35.4%** of applicants,
compared with 72.1-92.8% elsewhere.
Demand is there; seats are the constraint.

## 4. First-term GPA predicts retention
Students with a first-term GPA below 2.0 are retained **63.9%** of the time, versus **95.6%**
for 3.5+. Winter-intake students are retained **81.9%** vs
**85.1%** for Fall. Mechanical Engineering Technician has the lowest retention
(**81.9%**, average GPA 2.79).

## Recommendations
1. **Rebalance recruitment toward domestic and diversified markets** to offset the international decline;
   set intake targets per program using the term trend, not the 2023 baseline.
2. **Add a pre-arrival support track for international admits** (visa checklist, deposit reminders,
   arrival dates) to lift the 66.7% show-up rate.
3. **Grow referral and alumni programs** and review agent contracts on conversion, not volume.
4. **Make the case for more Nursing seats** (or a waitlist-to-bridging pathway) given unmet demand.
5. **Flag students below 2.0 GPA after first-term grades** for advising and tutoring, with
   extra onboarding for Winter intake and Mechanical Engineering Technician.
